title: Learning by nudging
description: How a model learns: a bigram table of scores, one gradient step on one example, the training loop with too small, good and too large learning rates, and generating text from the trained table.

stations.title: Generate, one character at a time

changelog: Resume: the full experiment (looked-up rows, nudged example and learning rate, training steps and learning rate, generated text, quiz answers, completed stations, focus) is saved via ptf/state and restored on reload; training is replayed from the step count. Starts in focus mode at the first station; the snapshot reports the nudge result and quiz answers.
